summary: The user reported that a stream visible in the browser became black after switching to the Flutter macOS client. Source review found that FlutterRTCVideoRenderer retained its pending texture-frame gate when the RTCVideoTrack changed. If the prior texture frame was never sampled, this gate could prevent the next track's frame from being uploaded. Added a test-first regression and reset the pending-frame flag under the renderer lock on track replacement in both the shared Darwin and macOS implementations. This is a plausible renderer lifecycle defect, not yet proven to be the cause of the user's live report.

limitations: The reported browser-to-macOS black screen was not reproduced with an active paired screen share.
A source-level test proves the pending-frame gate resets on track replacement, not that this condition caused the reported black image or that the physical renderer displays pixels after switching.
